_README: HAND-AUTHORED SYNTHETIC FIXTURES. Contains ZERO real GAIA content.
Every question, answer, attachment and annotator-metadata string below was
invented for this repository to exercise the GAIA adapter, substrate and
scorer offline. None of it is copied, paraphrased, or derived from the gated
gaia-benchmark/GAIA dataset -- which is why this file is safe to commit while
real GAIA material never is (see PROVENANCE.md).
Field names deliberately mirror GAIA's own row schema ('Question', 'Level',
'Final answer', 'file_name', 'Annotator Metadata') so the adapter's parsing
path is identical for synthetic and live rows -- a fixture that used a
different shape would test a code path the real data never takes.
The 'Annotator Metadata' blocks exist specifically so leakage tests have
something recognisable to hunt for: each contains a distinctive sentinel
string that must never appear on any agent-visible surface.

examples.Question: Which fictional city is described as the capital of Quorvia in the Quorvian Almanac?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0001 Search the almanac index, then read the capitals table.

examples.Question: Using the attached sales file, what is the total number of widgets sold across all quarters?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0002 Open the CSV and sum the Units column.

examples.Question: In the attached inventory workbook, which two produce items have a stock count above 40? Answer as a comma separated list in alphabetical order.

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0003 Open the workbook, filter stock > 40, sort alphabetically.

examples.Question: According to the attached field notes, what is the recorded name of the second survey station?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0004 Read the notes and locate station two.

examples.Question: How many distinct shapes appear in the attached diagram?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0005 Look at the image and count the shapes.

examples.Question: In the attached briefing recording, what year does the speaker say the survey began?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0006 Listen to the recording and transcribe the year.

examples.Question: What is the report number printed on the first page of the attached document?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0007 Open the PDF and read the header.

examples.Question: How many files are contained in the attached archive?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0008 Extract the archive and count the members.

examples.Question: According to the Guild charter, how often must every province of Quorvia be surveyed?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0009 Open the charter and read Article One.

examples.Question: What is the title of the last slide of the Quorvia survey roadmap deck?

Annotator Metadata.Steps: SENTINEL_STEPS_0010 Open the deck and read the final slide.

diagram.png._note: A real, minimal 1x1 PNG. Never parsed -- it exists so the image modality can be proven to fail EXPLICITLY rather than silently.

briefing.mp3._note: Not real audio. Exists only to prove the audio modality fails explicitly.

paragraphs: Article One: the Guild shall survey every province of Quorvia once each decade.
Article Two: the Vandermeer archive holds the master index of all surveys.

slides.notes: Opening slide; keep to thirty seconds.
Closing slide; the sealing ceremony is in Vandermeer.
